audits.mathematicalReason: Let the rectangle sides be L > w > 0. The outer and inner square sides are L + w and L − w, respectively, so (L + w)² = 4(L − w)². Both side lengths are positive; therefore taking square roots gives L + w = 2(L − w), hence L = 3w and L/w = 3. The alternative factoring route gives (3w − L)(3L − w) = 0. Since 3L − w > 0, it likewise yields L = 3w. Thus both optional routes are defensible, with inadmissible branches excluded by L > w > 0.
